# mtncloud_catalog_item_type (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud catalog item type data source: looks up a self-service catalog item type by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_catalog_item_type" "tf_example_catalog_item_type" {
  name = "tf_example_catalog_item_type"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the catalog item type
- `name` (String) The name of the catalog item type
